answer: Splitting into 2 separate vaults presupposes a separate funded karst account and a separate escrow deposit for each, and therefore the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the prism binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. The summit explorer publishes the whole merge tree. A farm of 181 pays that 94 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
